name: Analyze Terminal Development Traces
description: Analyze traces from terminal vessel development to detect patterns, failures, and improvement opportunities

prompt.template:
Fetch development traces:
1. Run: curl -s 'https://activity.metabob.com/v2/activities/execution-traces?activity_id=terminal-observe-feature-development&limit=20' -H 'Authorization: ApiKey $METABOB_API_KEY' > /tmp/terminal-traces.json
2. Verify: jq '.traces | length' /tmp/terminal-traces.json

Analyze failure patterns:
1. Extract failures: jq '.traces[] | select(.status == "failed")' /tmp/terminal-traces.json > /tmp/terminal-failures.json
2. Count by failure type: jq -s 'group_by(.tasks[] | select(.status == "failed") | .task_id) | map({task: .[0].tasks[] | select(.status == "failed") | .task_id, count: length})' /tmp/terminal-failures.json > /tmp/terminal-failure-patterns.json
3. Find most common: jq 'sort_by(.count) | reverse | .[0]' /tmp/terminal-failure-patterns.json > /tmp/terminal-top-failure.json

tasks.description: Calculate success rate for terminal development

prompt.template:
Calculate metrics:
1. Total: jq '.traces | length' /tmp/terminal-traces.json > /tmp/terminal-total.txt
2. Successes: jq '[.traces[] | select(.status == "completed")] | length' /tmp/terminal-traces.json > /tmp/terminal-successes.txt
3. Success rate: TOTAL=$(cat /tmp/terminal-total.txt); SUCCESS=$(cat /tmp/terminal-successes.txt); echo "scale=3; $SUCCESS / $TOTAL" | bc > /tmp/terminal-success-rate.txt
4. Report: cat /tmp/terminal-success-rate.txt

Detect slow executions:
1. Extract durations: jq '.traces[].duration_ms' /tmp/terminal-traces.json > /tmp/terminal-durations.txt
2. Calculate mean: awk '{sum+=$1} END {print sum/NR}' /tmp/terminal-durations.txt > /tmp/terminal-mean-duration.txt
3. Calculate stddev: awk '{x+=$1;y+=$1^2}END{print sqrt(y/NR-(x/NR)^2)}' /tmp/terminal-durations.txt > /tmp/terminal-stddev.txt
4. Find outliers: MEAN=$(cat /tmp/terminal-mean-duration.txt); STDDEV=$(cat /tmp/terminal-stddev.txt); THRESHOLD=$(echo "$MEAN + 2 * $STDDEV" | bc); jq --argjson threshold $THRESHOLD '.traces[] | select(.duration_ms > $threshold) | {execution_id, duration_ms}' /tmp/terminal-traces.json > /tmp/terminal-slow-executions.json

tasks.description: Generate improvement suggestions based on patterns

prompt.template:
Generate suggestions:
1. Check success rate: SUCCESS_RATE=$(cat /tmp/terminal-success-rate.txt)
2. If < 0.7: echo 'HIGH_FAILURE_RATE: Consider creating activity variant' > /tmp/terminal-suggestions.txt
3. Check for common failure: COMMON_FAILURE=$(jq -r '.task' /tmp/terminal-top-failure.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'none')
4. If common failure exists: echo "COMMON_FAILURE: Task $COMMON_FAILURE fails frequently - review implementation" >> /tmp/terminal-suggestions.txt
5. Count slow executions: SLOW_COUNT=$(jq -s 'length' /tmp/terminal-slow-executions.json 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
6. If > 2: echo "PERFORMANCE_ISSUE: $SLOW_COUNT slow executions detected" >> /tmp/terminal-suggestions.txt
7. Report all suggestions: cat /tmp/terminal-suggestions.txt

tasks.description: Create GitHub issues for detected patterns

prompt.template:
Create issues for findings:
1. Read suggestions: cat /tmp/terminal-suggestions.txt
2. For each HIGH_FAILURE_RATE: gh issue create --title 'Terminal development success rate below 70%' --body "Success rate: $(cat /tmp/terminal-success-rate.txt). Review traces." --label 'automated-detection,terminal-vessel'
3. For each COMMON_FAILURE: gh issue create --title "Terminal development: Task $(jq -r '.task' /tmp/terminal-top-failure.json) fails frequently" --body "Failing in $(jq -r '.count' /tmp/terminal-top-failure.json) executions." --label 'automated-detection,terminal-vessel'
4. For each PERFORMANCE_ISSUE: gh issue create --title 'Terminal development: Performance anomalies detected' --body "$(cat /tmp/terminal-slow-executions.json)" --label 'automated-detection,performance,terminal-vessel'
